## [The shipping is taking too long](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a2c6c7bc6cf23001d0324e4)
The shipping is taking too long. I was contacted to schedule a delivery and then the day before told that it needs to be rescheduled. Called and found out it hasn't actually shipped at all. Seems like a weird system.

May 28, 2026

* * *

Useful

Share

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jun 15, 2026

Thank you for sharing your feedback. We're very sorry to hear about the confusion and delays you experienced with your delivery.

We understand how frustrating it is to schedule a delivery, only to be notified that it needs to be rescheduled and then learn that the shipment had not yet reached the delivery stage. This is not the experience we strive to provide.

A member of our Customer Experience team will be reaching out to further assist you and provide an update on your order. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience as we work to make this right.
